text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Was it... just my imagination? I 
could have sworn I heard a voice calling 
me――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
............ No way... Could it be the 
Three Goddesses...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. What on earth am I thinking? 
Something like a storybook tale—
